title: Set Age Deduction on Treadwear Credits — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty
content:
**Age deduction on the treadwear adjustment credit — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty.** The age deduction is taken off the unreceived share of the credit, before the share is rounded down to a whole percent, and never takes it below 0. It follows the set's age — the whole calendar months from the purchase date to today — and its miles run (the latest tread inspection odometer less the install odometer), each measured against half of the line's figures.

| Set's age | Miles run | Deduction |
|---|---|---|
| at least half of the line's warranty term | below half of the line's warranted miles | 1 point for every month elapsed beyond half of the warranty term |
| at least half of the line's warranty term | at least half of the line's warranted miles | a flat 4 points, whatever the age |
| younger than half of the line's warranty term | any | no deduction |

| Line | Warranty term | Half the term | Warranted miles | Half the miles |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Value Touring 40K Treadwear Warranty | 48 months | 24 months | 40,000 | 20,000 |
| Crestline All-Season 50K Treadwear Warranty | 60 months | 30 months | 50,000 | 25,000 |
| Crestline Grand Touring 60K Treadwear Warranty | 60 months | 30 months | 60,000 | 30,000 |
| Crestline Highway Terrain LT 65K Treadwear Warranty | 60 months | 30 months | 65,000 | 32,500 |
| Crestline Premium Touring 75K Treadwear Warranty | 72 months | 36 months | 75,000 | 37,500 |
| Crestline Ultra Touring 85K Treadwear Warranty | 72 months | 36 months | 85,000 | 42,500 |

Warranty terms in line order: 48, 60, 60, 60, 72, 72 months; warranted miles: 40000, 50000, 60000, 65000, 75000, 85000.

**Worked (hypothetical set on a 60-month line warranted for 50,000 miles):** 38 months old with 20,000 miles run — 8 months beyond 30, so 8 points off; 38 months old with 26,000 miles run — 4 points off; 29 months old — nothing off. An unreceived share of 6.4 less 8 points is 0.
